recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7852 unless a separate future issue asks to revise the clinical correctness of individual v2 field choices.
issue_request: FHIR-7852 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care change request from the DSTU1 ballot asking for AllergyIntolerance to have HL7 v2 mappings because the resource aligned with the AL1 segment. The accepted resolution was to add mappings to both IAM and AL1.
initial_application: The issue was applied in the legacy spreadsheet source before this reconciliation. Jira records Grahame's 2016-03-29 comment "added. svn revision 8096". Git history shows 5f27be6a8d5ae1e00f644ef9ebf6f6bbebcba0f6 adding several IAM mappings and an AL1/IAM code mapping, 7b1d9f6dbef8833585b1bc1c96c624288ec4ac93 (git-svn revision 8096) adding the remaining AL1 fields requested by the issue, and 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 converting the spreadsheet to the current StructureDefinition XML while retaining the mappings.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition declares the HL7 V2 mapping identity and includes AL1 mappings for category, criticality, code/substance, reaction manifestation, and reaction onset, plus IAM mappings for identifier, type, code, recorder/asserter-related fields, and other fields. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related final issue or community discussion that reverses or narrows FHIR-7852.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already carries the AL1 and IAM mappings required by the issue, including each AL1 field named in the Jira comments.
